svg.title: How does mortality rate from respiratory disease, all ages vary across counties and unitary authorities?
svg.desc: How does mortality rate from respiratory disease, all ages vary across counties and unitary authorities?. Mortality rate from respiratory disease, all ages — Counties and unitary authorities, 2023 - 25 (England coverage). Quantile (equal count), 5 classes, computed from the 151 areas with a value. 151 areas have a value; 2 have none; 0 are suppressed; 65 are outside dataset coverage.

svg.text: In North Yorkshire, mortality rate from respiratory disease, all ages was 97.16 per 100,000 in 2023 - 25 (directly age-standardised

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rate, all persons, all ages). That is 16.07 per 100,000 lower than England (113.2 per 100,000) for the same period, a relative

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: difference of 14%. The publisher's own significance flag records this area as statistically significantly better than England. Compared

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with 2022 - 24, the value is 1.82 per 100,000 higher. This is a difference between two periods, not an established trend. The

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: confidence intervals for the two periods overlap.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Indicator: Mortality rate from respiratory disease, all ages (Fingertips indicator 93963).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure: Directly age-standardised rate, per 100,000. Population: Persons, All ages.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Geography: Counties and unitary authorities, boundaries May 2023.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Period: 2023 - 25 (3-year pooled). Benchmark: England.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Classification: Quantile (equal count), 5 classes, computed from the 151 areas with a value.
